title: Punjab 2025: rivers spread across the monsoon floodplain
location: Lower Chenab near Multan, Punjab, Pakistan
headline: Follow Lower Chenab near Multan, Punjab, Pakistan across 4 real radar observations
introduction: 4 calibrated Sentinel-1 C-band VV radar acquisitions over this focused study area. The image dates are actual acquisitions from 2025-08-01 to 2025-09-18. These historical observations are not NISAR data.
conclusion: This sequence shows terrain-corrected radar response across the event period. Moisture, vegetation and surface roughness also affect brightness. This is not a validated water classification or a national flood-area estimate. The processed area is the explicitly mapped local subregion.

properties.name: Lower Chenab near Multan, Punjab, Pakistan
properties.scope: Focused subregion, not the full national event

method: Sentinel-1 RTC, consistent polarization and orbit per story. Source calibrated power converted using 10*log10 where necessary; existing dB sources are not converted again. Bilinear alignment to the first grid, invalid/nonpositive power masked, fixed viridis −30 to +5 dB display. Statistics are radar response, not classified flood area.
